description:
I am the owner of the property, and I am asking permission for 2 sqm Single Story, Nonheritable Side Extension with a Front open Canopy, added on the side of the dwelling - mirroring  the existing side extension at the neighbouring property (No. 42  ref ..) front wall will be in line for both properties, ensuring visual consistency within the street scene. The additional 2sqm floor area will provide a modest, functional space used as boot room for wet cotes. The proposed extension has been designed to fill out a gab that look out of place, to create a balanced, uniform street front to be subservient to the host dwelling and to integrate harmoniously visually with neighbouring properties 
Materials will match the existing building, including roof finishes, ensuring visual continuity. The scale and position of the extension ensure that neighbouring amenity is preserved in accordance with planning policies, Sustainability and Energy Efficiency  The existing porch, which was in a poor and deteriorated condition, has been safely removed. We would like to replace it with a small fully open canopy. This design reflects character and will enhance the appearance of the front elevation. The canopy will be positioned a minimum of 150 mm from the boundary with No. 42, in agreement with the adjoining neighbour. Written confirmation can be provided if required.
The canopy replaces a previously demolished front porch and occupies the exact same width footprint as the original structure. By removing the separate porch and introducing a continuous canopy tied directly into the side extension, the design removes unnecessary clutter from the front elevation. We are proposing a clean, unified, and architecturally integrated aesthetic that improves the property's visual appeal while maintaining a footprint that is completely consistent with the historic built form of the dwelling. As it is an open-fronted canopy of identical width, it has zero impact on the street scene or the amenities of neighbouring properties. The proposal has been discussed informally with neighbouring residents, who have expressed support for us. The extension follows existing building line and mirrors the neighbouring side extension at No. 42, (PAPP number) resulting in no adverse impact on daylight, outlook, or privacy. 
As part of the wider improvement works, the proposal includes external wall insulation (50 mm) with rendered finish to all exposed elevations of the house. This will significantly improve the thermal efficiency of the building, reduce energy demand, and lower CO₂ emissions.
We are asking for a modest, well-considered improvement to the dwelling. It respects the character of the area, mirrors the neighbour’s extension and building line , preserves residential amenity and delivers sustainability benefits.
We will comply with relevant local and national planning policies, and approval is respectfully requested.
decision_conditions: existing and proposed elevations and floor plans required all with scale bar to scale in metric
